item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying bcud dril gyi dgra chos myur mgyogs srog len
item.coloph: ces mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying bcud du dril zhing dgra bo rming med du brlag pa'i las kha lha srung dam bdar gzan 'gyed myur mgyogs srog len 'di yang hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin rten 'brel nyi ma rtse shar gzi 'od rgyas pa'i dus su bstan 'dzin skyes mchog ri 'brug chen po'i gar rol tshul khrims blo gros kyi gzigs ngog nas rang 'byung rdo yi sgrom bu rang dbye ru gyur nas pha nor bu yi dbang skal du dngos grub babs pa 'di yang dad ldan bu slob 'ga' dang khyad par bka' 'bangs g.yung drung rgya mtsho nas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des shar grol smin gling du bla chen dran pa'i phyag bris shog ser ngos nas dag par dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'dis kyang bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod pa'i rgyur gyur cig
